instruction: Grab a pair of the synthetic shoe upper, place left tips in the rectangular Nike box for shoes.

source.instruction: Grab a pair of the synthetic shoe upper, place left tips in the rectangular Nike box for shoes.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the left_shoe, which was at x = -25 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the right_shoe, which was at x = +22 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 64
frames.plan: Move left arm toward left shoe at (-25, -2, 94), point down, and rotate yaw +30 degrees to match orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+5, +17, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +30 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lower left arm toward left shoe to z=78 cm. Move right arm to (22, -3, 94) above the right shoe and point down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -16) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-9, +16, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +30 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 78) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 64
frames.plan: Rotate right gripper yaw +80 degrees to align with right shoe, and lower right arm to z=78 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -16) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 78) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 78) opening 0.95; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lower left gripper further to z=68 cm to grasp the left shoe.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 68) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 78) opening 0.95; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=68 cm to grasp right shoe, then close both grippers.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe; closed the gripper (opening 0.71: holding the left_shoe); RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe; closed the gripper (opening 0.71: holding the right_shoe)

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 68) opening 0.71; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 68) opening 0.71; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lift both arms up by 15 cm to z=83 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +15) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +15) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -2, 83) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 83) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lift left arm slightly to z=88 cm and move it to (-1, -17) over the Nike box.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+24, -15, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -17, 88) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 83) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Orient left shoe horizontally (yaw +90), lower left arm to z=81 cm into box, and lift right arm to z=88 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -17, 81) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (22, -3, 88) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Move right arm toward the right side of the workspace to make room, down to z=83 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+10, -5, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -17, 81) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (32, -8, 83) opening 0.74; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lower left arm to z=76 cm and open left gripper to release the shoe.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -17, 76) opening 0.70; RIGHT fingertips (32, -8, 83) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Home left arm to clear space. Lift right arm to z=88 cm and move over the box to x=1 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-30, -3, +18) cm, now 29 cm (horizontal) / +29 cm (vertical) from the left_shoe; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-31, +0, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (1, -8, 88) opening 0.74; table z = 64
frames.plan: Move right arm slightly in y, rotate yaw -90 degrees to align horizontally, and lower to z=80 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, -1, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, -8, 80) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Fine-tune right arm position slightly in x and y, and re-orient yaw -90 degrees.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the right_shoe

frames.label: turn 14
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, -9, 80) opening 0.73; table z = 64
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=75.5 cm into the box and open gripper to release shoe.
